clips.text_zh: 22歲做doge贏咗，買咗condo USD230K，之後無晒錢。返學grad咗，依家人工USD100K，住緊自己condo，27歲覺得日日返工消費循環，揹住student debt同card debt，好撚灰。
clips.text_en_b1: In 2021 I was 22 and made random crypto money from Dogecoin. I lived two years with no job, dropped out of school and bought a condo for $230K. Then money ran out. I went back to school, graduated, and now I earn $100K living in my condo. I am 27 and feel stuck in a cycle of work, consume, repeat.
clips.source_hint: /biz/ anon regretting early crypto win and condo purchase
clips.text_en_b2: I made decent money from Dogecoin back in 2021 when I was 22, dropped out of school and blew most of it on a $230K condo. Two years of doing nothing later, I went back, graduated, and now pull in $100K a year living in the place. The thing is, although the salary sounds alright on paper, I am stuck in this endless work-spend-repeat loop, weighed down by student loans and credit card debt, and frankly I hate that I once tasted financial freedom and…
clips.text_en_c1: Back in 2021, at twenty-two, I stumbled into a windfall from Dogecoin and convinced myself the easy money would last indefinitely. For two years I dropped out of university, lived without employment, and purchased a condominium for $230,000. Predictably, the capital evaporated, and I was forced to resume my studies. Having since graduated, I now earn $100,000 annually while still residing in that same unit, aged twenty-seven and entrenched in what feels like an inescapable loop of labour, consumption, and repetition. The student loans, combined with mounting credit-card balances, have become a constant source of despair.
clips.text_en_c2: At twenty-two, I stumbled into a windfall on Dogecoin and, flush with what felt like inexhaustible means, dropped out of university and acquired a condominium for roughly $230,000. Two idle years followed, then the coffers ran dry. I re-enrolled, eventually graduated, and now, at twenty-seven, I draw a salary of $100,000 while still occupying that same condo. The irony is not lost on me: I tasted early affluence, returned to the treadmill of wage labour, and emerged burdened by lingering student loans and credit-card debt. Each morning brings the same Sisyphean loop of commuting, consuming, and paying down what I once thought I had transcended.

clips.text_zh: Cramer推文出嚟，ALL CAPS講油價USD150就嚟。睇返futures同CFD板塊即刻起泡，prop firm啲倉全開晒。btw wti又破頂，黃金仲喺度backwardation，搞唔掂。
clips.text_en_b1: HAPPENING: OIL $150 IS ABOUT TO BE REALITY BROS. Cramer just posted on X that crude is heading to $150 a barrel. /biz/ is spamming futures and CFD screenshots. WTI just broke out, gold is in backwardation, and prop firm accounts are blowing up. One anon says this is the squeeze of the decade. Brace for impact.

signal.rationale: Cramer's oil breakout post implies macro inflation hedge via gold and crude

clips.text_en_b2: Cramer just dropped an all-caps tweet claiming crude is heading for $150 a barrel, and /biz/ has gone into full meltdown. Futures and CFD screenshots are flooding the thread, WTI just broke out decisively, gold is sliding into backwardation, and prop firm accounts are getting wiped out left and right. While nobody can confirm whether this is actually the squeeze of the decade, anons are bracing for impact and refreshing tickers every thirty seconds.
clips.text_en_c1: Cramer has taken to X with an all-caps proclamation that crude is destined for $150 a barrel, a claim that has sent the futures and CFD boards into immediate overdrive. WTI has decisively broken out of its recent range, gold futures remain stuck in backwardation, and several prop firm accounts have already been decimated. If this trajectory holds, the squeeze may well prove historic in scale. Whether or not the call holds water, retail participants on /biz/ are bracing for a genuinely catastrophic move in energy markets over the coming weeks.
clips.text_en_c2: Cramer, in a characteristic burst of all-caps theatrics on X, has pronounced that crude is destined for $150 a barrel, and the resulting hysteria on /biz/ is, frankly, magnificent. Anons are flooding the thread with CFD screenshots and futures ladders as though evidence alone could summon the move. WTI has, in fact, staged a convincing breakout, while gold's persistent backwardation hints at deeper dislocation in the commodity complex. Prop firm accounts, leveraged to the hilt, are combusting in real time. Whether this constitutes the squeeze of the decade or merely another febrile episode remains, as ever, contingent on positioning. Brace accordingly.

clips.text_zh: 靠AI續命就真係得我一個人。Anthropic有researcher Jacob Coxon劈炮，話自己訓練嘅model開始識自我改進，怕失控毁滅人類。ok我fe都未考完，AI已經諗住炒我。
clips.text_en_b1: Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon quit on Tuesday. He trains new AI models by feeding them huge amounts of data. He said he is leaving because he does not want to join the industry-wide race to build AI systems that can improve themselves. He worries such systems could spiral out of control and destroy humanity.
clips.source_hint: /g/ thread on Anthropic researcher quitting over AI self-improvement fears

signal.rationale: AI safety story, no trade setup

clips.text_en_b2: Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon handed in his resignation on Tuesday, and the AI safety crowd is paying close attention. His job involves training new models by feeding them massive datasets, which is precisely why he refuses to stick around. Although competitors keep racing to build systems capable of self-improvement, Coxon made it clear he wants no part of it, because he genuinely fears these models could spiral out of control and pose an existential threat to humanity.
clips.text_en_c1: Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon tendered his resignation on Tuesday, a departure that has cast the company's safety credentials into sharper relief. His work involves training frontier models on enormous datasets, and he has explicitly stated that he refuses to participate in what he describes as an industry-wide arms race toward self-improving artificial intelligence. Coxon's underlying concern, articulated at length, is that such systems could spiral beyond human oversight with catastrophic, potentially civilisation-ending consequences. His exit underscores a growing tension within the field regarding pace, accountability, and existential risk.
clips.text_en_c2: Jacob Coxon, a researcher at Anthropic whose work involves curating vast corpora used to train frontier models, tendered his resignation on Tuesday, citing a principled refusal to participate in what he characterised as an industry-wide arms race toward self-improving artificial intelligence. His concerns, articulated with rare candour, centre on the possibility that such systems might recursively optimise themselves beyond human oversight and, in the worst case, precipitate civilisational ruin. It is, perhaps, a testament to our peculiar moment that existential anxieties about superintelligence have entered the mainstream discourse of ML practitioners, even as the rest of us fret over more terrestrial indignities.

clips.text_zh: 中國聲稱唔用EUV都做到2nm，4chan pol友集體崩潰。講真TSM同ASML條supply chain即刻被人拎嚟鞭，香港呢邊無晶片廠，不過睇住NVDA同台股有冇反應先。
clips.text_en_b1: CHINA HAS REACHED 2NM WITHOUT EVEN USING EUV. IT IS IMPOSSIBLE TO COMPETE WITH THE CHINESE SUPERMAN. The /pol/ thread is losing its mind over SMIC's reported 2nm node. Western fabs use ASML EUV machines that cost over $200 million each. SMIC allegedly used older DUV tools with multi-patterning. No one outside China has confirmed this yet.
clips.source_hint: /pol/ thread on China reaching 2nm without EUV lithography

signal.rationale: Geopolitical chip news, no actionable trade

clips.text_en_b2: SMIC has reportedly hit a 2nm node using older DUV machines with multi-patterning rather than ASML's EUV tools, and /pol/ is melting down over it. Western fabs rely on EUV scanners that run over $200 million each, so the claim that China skipped the tech entirely has Western tech posters frothing. While SMIC has not officially confirmed the milestone and outside observers remain sceptical, the thread is already bracing for Nvidia and Taiwan stocks to react on Monday.
clips.text_en_c1: Reports emerging from China suggest SMIC has achieved a 2nm node without recourse to ASML's prohibitively expensive EUV machinery, each unit of which carries a price tag exceeding $200 million. The alleged workaround reportedly leverages legacy DUV tools combined with aggressive multi-patterning techniques, a feat that, if substantiated, would constitute a watershed moment for the global semiconductor industry. The /pol/ thread has predictably descended into collective hysteria, though no independent verification has yet emerged. Watch NVIDIA and Taiwanese equities closely; the market reaction will be telling.
clips.text_en_c2: SMIC's purported achievement of a 2-nanometre node without recourse to ASML's prohibitively expensive EUV lithography—each machine commanding upwards of $200 million—has, predictably, sent /pol/ into paroxysms of impotent fury. The claim hinges on multi-patterning techniques executed with older deep-ultraviolet tools, a feat that strains credulity yet cannot be summarily dismissed given Beijing's strategic motivations. Independent verification remains elusive; Western fabs and Taiwanese analysts alike maintain a studied silence. For Hong Kong observers, who lack domestic fabrication capacity, the prudent posture is simply to monitor NVDA's after-hours reaction and broader Asian semiconductor sentiment before drawing conclusions.

clips.text_zh: 肥仔信問我幾時先cut返，我話仲未得。睇返fit thread有人由83kg肥到65kg skinnyfat，再lean bulk返80kg，flat bench 1 plate 3x8，squat 90kg，deadlift 120kg。都好撚勁，我要追。
clips.text_en_b1: In May 2025 I was 83kg fat with almost no muscle. I cut hard until mid-April 2026 and got down to 65kg, too skinnyfat to even bench the 20kg bar. Then I lean bulked until now and I am back at 80kg. My lifts are bench 3x8 at one plate, squat 3x6 at 90kg, and deadlift 3x8 at 120kg.
clips.source_hint: /fit/ thread on when to stop lean bulk and start cut

signal.rationale: Lifting progress post, no trade relevance

clips.text_en_b2: Back in May 2025 I was carrying 83kg of pure fat with basically no muscle underneath, so I cut hard until mid-April 2026 and dropped all the way down to a skinnyfat 65kg, barely able to bench the empty 20kg bar. I then ran a clean lean bulk and am now sitting around 80kg, although my physique looks nothing like my old 80kg self. Current lifts are bench 3x8 at one plate, squat 3x6 at 90kg, and deadlift 3x8 at 120kg.
clips.text_en_c1: In May 2025 I tipped the scales at a flabby eighty-three kilograms, carrying negligible muscle mass. A prolonged cut brought me down to sixty-five kilograms by April 2026, at which point I had crossed the threshold into textbook skinnyfat territory and could no longer even press the empty twenty-kilogram bar. Subsequently embarking on a lean bulk, I have since returned to eighty kilograms, though the composition differs markedly. My current working lifts include flat bench at one plate for three sets of eight, squats at ninety kilograms, and deadlifts at one hundred and twenty.
clips.text_en_c2: In May 2025 I presented as a soft 83 kilograms with negligible muscular development, whereupon I committed to an aggressive cut that persisted until mid-April 2026, bottoming out at a gaunt 65 kilograms too depleted to bench even the unloaded barbell. Subsequently I undertook a measured lean bulk, and presently weigh approximately 80 kilograms, a figure that superficially mirrors my earlier composition yet conceals substantive hypertrophy. My working lifts now stand at bench press three sets of eight at one plate, squat three sets of six at 90 kilograms, and deadlift three sets of eight at 120 kilograms. The dilemma of timing the next cut persists.

clips.text_zh: Soremachi作者Ishiguro親自rank自己manga角色，仲畫埋泳裝版。Ebi-chan係佢小學初戀原型，Kon-senpai就無份但SD版出現喺gag manga。睇完好撚治癒，又係學費嘅一個晚上。
clips.text_en_b1: Soremachi creator Ishiguro ranked his favourite characters from his own manga and drew them in swimsuits. He also talked about random stuff on stream. Kon-senpai is not in the ranking but her SD version appears in the gag manga. Ebi-chan is based on his first crush from elementary school. The video is 20 minutes long.
clips.source_hint: /a/ thread on Soremachi author ranking his own characters

signal.rationale: Anime cultural thread, no trade relevance

clips.text_en_b2: Soremachi creator Ishiguro hopped on stream, ranked his favourite characters from his own manga, and even drew them in swimsuits while rambling about random stuff. Kon-senpai did not make the ranking, although her super-deformed version keeps popping up in the gag manga. Ebi-chan, meanwhile, is apparently based on his first crush from elementary school. The whole video runs about twenty minutes, and while it is oddly soothing to watch, I have once again wasted another evening when I should have been studying.
clips.text_en_c1: Ishiguro, the creator behind Soremachi, recently took to streaming to rank his personal favourite characters from the series, even illustrating several in swimwear for added effect. While Kon-senpai failed to secure a spot on the official list, her super-deformed counterpart continues to feature prominently in the accompanying gag manga. Ebi-chan, by his own admission, was modelled on a childhood crush from primary school. The resulting twenty-minute video has proven wonderfully therapeutic, though my tuition bill continues to mount with alarming indifference.
clips.text_en_c2: Ishiguro, the author of Soremachi, recently conducted a stream in which he undertook the unenviable task of ranking his own characters and rendered several in swimwear variants, thereby occasioning considerable delight among viewers. He regaled the audience with ancillary reminiscences, including the revelation that Ebi-chan is modelled upon an elementary-school infatuation, which lends the character an unexpected autobiographical resonance. Kon-senpai, conspicuously absent from the formal ranking, nonetheless materialises in the gag manga via a chibi iteration. The broadcast, running some twenty minutes, exemplifies the peculiar alchemy whereby an author's self-indulgence transmutes, almost magically, into the reader's tuition fee.
